k:静.mnemonic: Under a deep blue (青) night sky a mother sets down her broom (ヨ), so that the sweeping will not wake the baby in the cradle (勹). Not a sound. Quiet.
k:静.hint: Broom set down by the cradle.

k:像.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who wants to be remembered as large as an elephant (象) has himself carved in stone at exactly that size. Statue (picture, image, portrait).

k:妻.mnemonic: A woman (女) jumps over a broom (ヨ) at her wedding, as the old custom goes. When she lands on the other side she is married. Wife (spouse).

k:延.mnemonic: A long stride (廴) that keeps going past the correct (正) finishing line: the walker carries on and the race is stretched out further. Prolong (stretching).

k:罪.mnemonic: A net (罒) dropped over an injustice (非): the wrongdoer is caught underneath it and hangs his head, knowing what he did. Guilt (sin, crime, blame).

k:才.mnemonic: A child who can complete (了) the hardest puzzle and then slide (ノ) off her chair to play, all before the others have read the question. Genius (years old).
k:才.hint: Puzzle done before the others start.

k:徳.mnemonic: On his daily stroll (彳) the old man carries a net (罒) holding ten (十) loaves and gives every one away with all his heart (心). Benevolence (virtue, goodness, commanding respect).

k:材.mnemonic: A tree (木) in the hands of a genius (才) carpenter: he sees the beams and planks inside it before he makes the first cut. Lumber (log, timber, materials).
k:材.hint: Carpenter sees beams in the tree.

k:暮.mnemonic: The day (日) is ending. The sun sinks behind the flowers (艹), looking big (大) and red on the horizon as it goes. Dusk (evening, twilight, live).
k:暮.hint: Big red sun behind the flowers.

k:模.mnemonic: A plastic tree (木) that only fools you at dusk (暮): in the half-light it looks real, and in the morning you see it is a fake. Imitation (copy, mock).
k:模.hint: Tree that looks real in half-light.

k:響.mnemonic: A sound (音) shouted across the borough (阝) is stubborn (艮): it bounces between the hills and comes back to you as a tiny (幺) voice. Echo (resound, ring, vibrate).

k:伯.mnemonic: A leader (亻) whose hair has turned white (白): the eldest of the family, the one everyone else defers to. Chief (count, earl, uncle).

k:宿.mnemonic: A roof (宀) fit for a chief (伯): when the chief travels, this is the house on the road where he stops to sleep. Inn (lodging, dwell, lodge).
k:宿.hint: Where the chief sleeps on the road.

k:徒.mnemonic: No horse and no cart. You stroll (彳) when you are tired and run (走) when you are late, but either way it is your own two legs. On foot (junior, emptiness, futility).

k:策.mnemonic: A raft of bamboo (竹) lashed to a tree (木) trunk, with a towel (巾) for a sail: the castaway's clever plan to get off the island. Scheme (plan, policy, means).
k:策.hint: Castaway's raft with a towel sail.

k:留.mnemonic: A guard with a sword (刀) keeps the traveller standing in the rice field (田), wrapped as tight as a cocoon (厶), until every question is answered. Detain (fasten, halt, stop).

k:企.mnemonic: A man in a hat (𠆢) comes to a stop (止) at the foot of the mountain, looks up, pulls the hat down firmly and decides to take it on. Undertake (scheme, attempt, plan).
k:企.hint: Hat pulled down before the climb.

k:板.mnemonic: A tree (木) made anti- (反) tree: no longer round and upright, but sawn flat and laid on its side. Board (plank, plate, stage).

k:攻.mnemonic: A strike (攵) against the enemy's construction (工): the army hammers at the half-built wall before it can be finished. Aggression (attack, criticize, polish).

k:辞.mnemonic: The old (古) minister gives the king a spicy (辛) piece of his tongue (舌), a few sharp words, and walks out of the job for good. Resign (word, term, expression).
k:辞.hint: Sharp words, then he walks out.

k:割.mnemonic: A knife (刂) does harm (害) to the cake, cutting it into shares, and each guest's slice is measured against the whole. Proportion (divide, cut, separate).

k:習.mnemonic: A chick with white (白) downy feathers (羽) flaps at the edge of the nest again and again, practising until it can fly. Learn (study, learning).
k:習.hint: Chick practising at the nest edge.

k:就.mnemonic: The towers of the capital (京) wobble (尤) in an earthquake, and for weeks every letter and every conversation is about that one subject. Concerning (settle, take position).
k:就.hint: All anyone talks about: wobbling towers.

k:章.mnemonic: For ten (十) perfect performances of sound (音), the musician is given a small medal to pin on her chest. Badge (chapter, composition, poem).

k:賀.mnemonic: A new member (員) is lifted by the power (力) of the whole club's arms and thrown into the air with cheers. Congratulations (joy).
k:賀.hint: New member tossed in the air.

k:薬.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) and tree (木) bark, dried in the day (日) sun and steeped in water from melted icicles (冫): the herbalist's remedy for a cough. Medicine (chemical, benefit).

k:毛.mnemonic: A single strand with short barbs across it and a tail curling off to the right, like one hair seen up close. Fur (hair, feather, down).

k:尾.mnemonic: A flag (尸) made of fur (毛), raised behind the dog and waved from side to side whenever it is pleased. Tail (end, finish).

k:振.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) pick up a clam (辰) and rattle it beside the ear to hear whether anything is inside. Shake (wave, wag, swing).
k:振.hint: Rattling a clam by the ear.
